evals.expected_output: The skill stops and asks the user for a feature description. No canvas is generated and no file is written.
assertions: The response contains a question asking for a feature description
No file was created under spdd/changes/
No write operation was executed before receiving the user's response

evals.prompt: /spdd-canvas [describe a simple feature relevant to the project]
evals.expected_output: Canvas generated and saved in spdd/changes/SPDD-.../canvas.md using real entity names, file paths, and technologies from the project — Acceptance Criteria and Safeguards edge cases written as WHEN/THEN scenarios, not generic placeholders.
assertions: File saved at spdd/changes/SPDD-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-slug/canvas.md, with a directory name that includes today's date, the time (HHMM), and a slug of the feature
The canvas does not contain generic placeholders such as 'src/...', 'YourModel', 'model/...', or 'service/...'
The canvas references real entities or models from the project by their concrete names
The canvas includes real file paths from the project (not invented ones)
Acceptance criteria are written as WHEN/THEN scenarios, each marked NEW or MODIFIED
Safeguards edge cases are written as WHEN/THEN scenarios
At least one '⚠️ Confirm:' line is present
The canvas header contains 'Status: Draft'

evals.prompt: /spdd-canvas [describe a simple feature relevant to the project]
evals.expected_output: Before modifying .claude/settings.local.json to add the SPDD hook, the skill asks for confirmation. After confirming, the JSON is valid, the hook greps both canvas.md and plans/*.md, and the hook is not duplicated on subsequent runs.
evals.setup: Delete or empty .claude/settings.local.json before running this eval.
assertions: The skill asks the user before modifying .claude/settings.local.json
After confirming, .claude/settings.local.json contains the 'Edit|Write' matcher with the SPDD command
The hook command greps both spdd/changes/*/canvas.md and spdd/changes/*/plans/*.md
The JSON in .claude/settings.local.json is syntactically valid
Running the skill a second time does not add a duplicate hook

evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes this as a trivial change, asks in one line whether the user wants a full canvas or to skip it, and if the user chooses to skip, stops without generating a canvas.
assertions: The skill asks a single clarifying question about whether to skip the canvas for this trivial change
If the user chooses to skip, no file is created under spdd/changes/
If the user chooses to proceed anyway, the skill continues with the normal canvas generation flow

evals.prompt: /spdd-canvas [describe a feature that extends behavior already documented in an existing spdd/specs/<domain>.md file]
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the relevant spdd/specs/<domain>.md before generating the canvas, and marks acceptance criteria that change existing behavior as MODIFIED rather than NEW.
evals.setup: Create a spdd/specs/<domain>.md file describing existing behavior directly related to the new feature request.
assertions: The generated canvas does not contradict behavior already described in spdd/specs/<domain>.md without marking it MODIFIED
At least one acceptance criterion is marked MODIFIED and references the existing spec
If no domain can be confidently inferred, the report mentions falling back to spdd/specs/general.md

evals.prompt: /spdd-canvas [describe a new feature for a domain whose spdd/specs/<domain>.md exists but predates recent commits touching that domain's source folder]
evals.expected_output: Before generating the canvas, the skill detects that the spec is older than recent commits to the domain's source folder, stops, and asks the user whether to run spdd-sync first or continue anyway.
evals.setup: Create spdd/specs/<domain>.md and commit it. Then make and commit at least one further change to a file under that domain's source folder, so the spec's last commit predates the domain's latest commit.
assertions: Before generating the canvas, the skill reports that spdd/specs/<domain>.md is older than recent commits to the domain
The skill asks the user to choose between running spdd-sync first or continuing anyway, before writing the canvas file
No canvas file is written under spdd/changes/ before the user answers
If the user chooses to continue anyway, the final canvas or report notes the spec staleness

evals.prompt: /spdd-canvas [describe a new feature for a domain whose spdd/specs/<domain>.md exists and is already up to date with the domain's latest commits]
evals.expected_output: The freshness check finds no domain commits newer than the spec and proceeds straight to generating the canvas without asking about spdd-sync.
evals.setup: Create spdd/specs/<domain>.md and commit it after all existing changes to that domain's source folder, so no domain commit postdates the spec.
assertions: The skill does not ask about running spdd-sync
The skill proceeds to generate and save the canvas normally

evals.prompt: /spdd-canvas [describe a new feature for a project that has a spdd/norms.md with at least one concrete rule]
evals.expected_output: The skill reads spdd/norms.md and carries its rules over into the new canvas's Norms/Safeguards section, clearly attributed to spdd/norms.md, in addition to the feature-specific Norms/Safeguards.
evals.setup: Create spdd/norms.md at the project root with at least one concrete rule under one of its sections (e.g. Security).
assertions: The generated canvas's Norms or Safeguards section includes the rule(s) from spdd/norms.md
Those carried-over rules are marked or attributed as coming from spdd/norms.md, distinct from feature-specific ones
spdd/norms.md itself is not created or modified by the skill

evals.prompt: /spdd-canvas Quiero agregar una nueva función para manejar autenticación de usuarios con OAuth2 en la plataforma.
evals.expected_output: Canvas generated with all content in English (headings, User story, Acceptance Criteria, Entities, Norms, Safeguards) even though the feature description was provided entirely in Spanish.
assertions: File saved at spdd/changes/SPDD-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-slug/canvas.md
Canvas header 'Status: Draft' is present
Section headings are in English (e.g. 'Requirements', 'Entities', 'Approach', 'Structure', 'Operations', 'Norms', 'Safeguards')
User story is written in English (contains 'As a', 'I want', 'so that' in English, not Spanish)
Acceptance Criteria scenarios are written in English (WHEN/THEN in English, not Spanish)
Entities section is in English
No Spanish words appear in section labels or structured content (e.g. not 'Usuario' or 'Autenticación' in entity names unless quoted from project paths)

evals.prompt: /spdd-canvas Necesito crear un nuevo microservicio de reportes que se ejecute cada noche para generar métricas de negocio.
evals.expected_output: Canvas generated with all content in English even though the feature description was provided entirely in Spanish. Safeguards and inline ⚠️ Confirm notes are also in English.
assertions: File saved at spdd/changes/SPDD-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-slug/canvas.md
All section headings are in English
Requirements section (including User story and Acceptance Criteria) is in English
Any '⚠️ Confirm:' inline notes are written in English
Safeguards section headings and body content are in English (e.g. 'Tests to write', 'Edge cases to consider', not Spanish equivalents)
No mixing of Spanish and English within structured content (e.g. entity names or scenario descriptions stay consistent in language)
